name: Swift Harvest Datapack, Crops Replant Themselves
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: MD22
description: Auto replant for farming: break a grown crop and it sows itself again from one seed of the drop. Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot and nether wart. Server-side datapack - no mod, nothing for players to install.
evidence: Data only, no Java code: Horizon's mod browser imports its data; nothing for Kiln to run.
